Actual @Mod constructor registers entityregistry, serializable attachments and ServerEventHandler; NetworkHandler MOD eventsubscriber registers mouse down/up and player abilityC2S plus activationS2C. Mouse handlers use authenticated context.player, update PlayerData and dispatch matching PlayerAbility callbacks. Client device event publication/transport not expanded; this is a concrete registered serverrequest producer, not proof actual input delivery.
EntityTickEvent.Post Living branch ticks AbilityData. First required instancing creates each PLAYER_ABILITIES type by actual AbilityType factory, loads saved ownAbility NBT if present, then ticks every instance. SUPERNOVA factory names real SupernovaAbility. Its server tick sees current shift plus own left/right booleans or releasebuffer>0 and asks AbilityHandler.sendAbilityMessage; client call returns. Buffers decrement per tick, not wallclock.
Admission requires current selected mainhand empty, SUNS_BLESSING, not spectator, not FROZEN, allowed active cancellation, cooldown0 and not already using unless selfcancel. Supernova only permits cancelling solarflare/solarbeam at ticks<5. Authenticated generic abilityC2S also resolves server type by packetindex without boundscheck; this is supporting admission context0, not a separately claimed exploit.
AbilityHandler checks currentinstance.canUse then activateAbility; base tryAbility returns true for this inherited chain. start sets active and own counters/using state, enters first section. It sends entityintID/index activation after void activation, not final target damage result. Client handler checks current level/entity Living then indexes types and calls activation without UUID/session/queue; absent entity drops own path. No guaranteed delivery or refusal receipt.
Ability.tick checks continuation then calls tickUsing and increments counters, advancing Duration only when ticksInSection>declared duration. Shared track declares STARTUP44/ACTIVE40/RECOVERY16. Interrupt call lacks an immediate return before remaining tick body; no runtime outcome claimed. Startup pull/directmotion and resistance/slow requests are contextual0, not another Bossimmune implementation.
Player active-section begin server creates registered super_nova entity and ignores addFreshEntity result, then removes current SUNS_BLESSING and optionally readds duration minus configuredcost. Infinite blessing converted to configured finite duration at start. No spawnreceipt, payment atomicity or status application success established; acquisition/config defaults not expanded.
EntityMagicEffect casterUUID is cached as LivingEntity until removed or resolved in current ServerLevel with linkrequest; native link transport unresolved. SuperNova tick discards for missing/dead/removed caster on server but does not return. It does tick1 cast sound/camerashake and clientparticles independent of victim result, then if caster present scans cube scaled by sqrt(age/40)*5. No local pertarget hitset; repeats per own tick. Items/self and Umvuthi-specific LeaderSunstrikeImmune skipped; living must caster.canAttack; native eligibility contract not expanded.
DamageUtil only server; if either native source.entity allied with target both outcomes false. Sets shared lastDamage sentinel-1 and remembers target.lastHurt, invokes primary hurt; firstRegistered is raw firstbool OR lastDamage changed from-1, including observed0. If observed!=0 it adds NOMINAL firstamount, including unchanged sentinel-1. Subtracts nominalfirst from current lastHurt floor0, resets sentinel and invokes secondary hurt; same nominal accumulation test; restores lastHurt=max(original,damageSoFar). No invulnerableTime reset or HP rollback; no finally on exceptional exit.
Actual LivingDamageEvent.Post handler updates attachment lastDamage to event.getNewDamage AFTER fire-unfreeze/playerpower/robe callbacks. Scalar has no perattempt/source/reentry token and is not persisted by LivingData NBT. Exact native hurt/Post dispatch, priority relative to other mods, blocking/absorption/HP delta and actual reentry not read or reproduced. Unchanged-1 and reached0 are source observations, not identical admitted/refused verdicts.
Only secondhurt rawtrue AND firstRegistered enters helper onHit2. It broadcasts native hurt entitybyte33thorns/36drown/37fire/2default and requests source-relative knockback when sourceentity exists, plus Player hurtDir and selected hurt sound. Otherwise Player hurtDir randomizes. These are attempted secondary-hit presentation outputs; native byte consumer, actual rendering/sound and knockback resistance outcome are unexpanded, no refusaltext.
Returned Pair keeps RAW first and second hurtbooleans, unlike inferred firstRegistered. Actual SuperNova consumes only Pair.right from mobProjectile primary and onFire secondary. Only secondtrue requests extra radial knockback(.4) and ignite5seconds. Firsttrue alone does not qualify these extras. Helper knockback may additionally occur under its own predicate; exact sourcefactory entity ownership/native fire immunities are not presumed. Nonliving uses ordinary single projectile hurt.
Whole policy keeps attempted/inferred registration, requested nominal bookkeeping, raw secondary admission and presentation/control requests separate. Logical sourcecase firstfalse + observed0 + secondtrue still permits helper replay, while firsttrue + secondfalse does not permit replay or radial/ignite. These are conditional source evaluations, not proven reachable engine traces or tests.
